name: Pleasing Others
overview: Scripture teaches that true service and pleasing others must be grounded in honoring God above all. Believers are called to present themselves as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, which is their reasonable service, rather than conforming to worldly standards. The renewal of the mind enables Christians to discern and fulfill God's good and perfect will. Ultimately, seeking to please men compromises our service to Christ, so all actions should be done wholeheartedly as unto the Lord, not merely to gain human approval.
